'''Joseph Lake''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Gold 33 FL from Taylor, Mi. The slot was marked Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run. He finished 29th of 49 at the [[1999 Corellia Regionals]] in Indianapolis with 6 (−45).<ref name="cec-reg" /> He lost to [[Frank Lamantia]] in the fourth game.

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support). "FL" is printed on some slots in the surviving tables.
